such as.sentence: We grow vegetables such as carrots and beans.
such as.translation: 我们种植胡萝卜、豆子等蔬菜。

at least.sentence: Please arrive at least ten minutes early.

used to.meaning: 过去常常（现在不再如此）
used to.sentence: We used to live near the sea.

due to.sentence: The flight was delayed due to heavy snow.

according to.sentence: According to the map, the station is nearby.
according to.translation: 根据地图，车站就在附近。

at all.sentence: I do not agree at all.

rather than.sentence: I chose tea rather than coffee.

of course.sentence: Of course you can join us.

instead of.sentence: We walked instead of taking a taxi.
instead of.translation: 我们没有打车，而是步行。

no longer.sentence: This ticket is no longer valid.

find out.sentence: I will find out when the shop opens.
find out.translation: 我会查清楚商店什么时候开门。

make sure.sentence: Please make sure the door is locked.

in fact.sentence: In fact, the trip was quite relaxing.
in fact.translation: 事实上，这次旅行很放松。

take care.sentence: Take care when you cross the road.

give up.sentence: Do not give up when the work gets difficult.

go ahead.sentence: Go ahead and open the box.

take off.sentence: The plane will take off at noon.

look after.sentence: Can you look after my cat this weekend?
look after.translation: 这个周末你能照顾我的猫吗？
